name: io.github.BrightbeamAI/chap
title: CHAP Coordinator
description: Auditable records of human decisions over AI agent work. Approvals, edits, overrides, escalations.

environmentVariables.name: CHAP_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a SQLite file. Without it the coordinator runs in memory and workspaces are lost when the client restarts.

environmentVariables.name: CHAP_PROFILES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated CHAP profiles enabled on new workspaces. Defaults to Core plus review, whisper, deliberation, handoff, control, routing, modes and audit-scitt.
